content: Root cause: The bug was caused by an attempt to dereference a pointer (`vioch->cinfo`) that had not been initialized, leading to a null pointer dereference when an error occurred during the call to `scmi_vio_feed_vq_rx()`. This happened because the error handling code was trying to access the device reference through `vioch->cinfo->dev`, which was not yet set up, instead of passing the device reference directly to the function.
